instruction: `ds/ll.py::to_list` drops the last node when converting a linked list back to a Python list. A single-node list comes back as `[]` and a three-node list as a two-element list, because the loop stops before visiting the final node; the empty list also raises instead of returning `[]`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds/ll.py b/ds/ll.py
--- a/ds/ll.py
+++ b/ds/ll.py
@@ -57,7 +57,7 @@
     """Convert a linked list back into a Python list."""
     out = []
     cur = head
-    while cur.nxt is not None:
+    while cur is not None:
         out.append(cur.value)
         cur = cur.nxt
     return out
